    • slot

      public SlotElement.Builder slot(SlotGroupId group, int index)
      Slot index of any group, found on whatever menu is open. A created group's id behaves as slot(SlotGroupId.Created, int). A category group's id (SlotGroupId.category(CHEST_STORAGE)) resolves on each menu to that group in SlotGroupCategories.groups(menu), so one element names the same slot on a single chest, a double chest and a barrel. The element isn't shown on a menu without the group, or where the group is shorter. The slot keeps everything vanilla gives it, as with slot(Address). Since 2.1.0.

    • slot

      public SlotElement.Builder slot(Address address)
      The vanilla slot to present: Address.menuSlot(net.minecraft.world.inventory.MenuType, int) for the same slot on every menu of a type, or a slot's container-based address from SlotRef.address() for one particular container. A created slot goes through slot(SlotGroupId.Created, int).
